title: GILMORE GIRLS
subtitle: skipto.tv
blurb: Seven seasons in Stars Hollow, charted season by season: Rory's boyfriends and Lorelai's, Chilton to Yale to the campaign trail, the Independence Inn to the Dragonfly, Friday night dinners, and the year the Palladinos weren't there.
regularsNote: Series regulars — Lorelai, Rory, Luke, Emily, Richard, Sookie, Lane, Paris, Michel, Kirk, Dean, Jess, Logan and the rest of the main cast — aren't listed here; this dropdown covers the guest and recurring cast, from Trix and Mrs. Kim's church friends to every Stars Hollow troubadour.
chartHint: Seven seasons across. Click any bar to filter the episode list; mid-season turns are drawn at season granularity with the exact episode in the label.
credits: Episode data, images and ratings from TVmaze. Chart hand-built from the series. The 2016 revival, A Year in the Life, is a separate TVmaze show and isn't included.
